note: This file is a MMDetection configuration file containing only dictionary-based hyperparameters and architecture settings for the BoxInst instance segmentation model. It has no callable functions, classes, or methods — it is a list of configuration variables consumed by the MMDetection training pipeline.
summarize_config: summarize the BoxInst ResNet-50 FPN instance segmentation model configuration for COCO dataset
review_model_architecture: review the BoxInst model architecture with ResNet-50 backbone and FPN neck settings
review_loss_functions: review the FocalLoss, GIoULoss, and DiceLoss configuration for BoxInst training
review_test_cfg: review the BoxInst test configuration including NMS threshold and mask threshold settings
review_data_preprocessor: review the BoxInstDataPreprocessor settings including normalization and pairwise color threshold
